principle: Biosphere and ecosystems derive from physical/environmental context and persist as world state; a biome label is not sufficient ecology.
rules: Life does not appear because a mission requests it.
Biome distribution must be compatible with climate, water, terrain and extraordinary influences.
Ecosystem state may change through fire, disease, climate shifts, colonization, terraforming or other explicit events.
Sapient population and natural ecosystem are separate layers.
Alien life may violate ordinary Earth expectations only with explicit setting/science rules.
